themes.title: AI trade rout: markets reprice the capex supercycle
themes.summary: Big Tech logged its biggest weekly drop since 'Liberation Day' as investors fled to Treasuries, while Asia's picks-and-shovels chip supply chain faces financing-cost pressure that could throttle the boom. The AI trade is now being priced by debt markets, not just model roadmaps, with CoreWeave's leverage and unequal semi losses adding to the anxiety.
themes.angle: The binding constraint on AI is no longer compute supply but the cost of capital behind it.

themes.title: AI oversight tightens: central banks, safety bills, espionage
themes.summary: Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey told the G30 central banks 'have got to address' AI agent concerns, flagging rapid AI development as a major financial-stability issue. The warning lands alongside Anthropic's own safety-bill push and the spying case against an OpenAI engineer, putting AI governance squarely in the executive risk portfolio.
themes.angle: Agentic AI has moved from a productivity story to a stability-and-security story; boards should treat it as such.

themes.title: GCC deploys at speed: policing to 2040, Jais 3, deepfake defence
themes.summary: Dubai Police unveiled ten AI opportunities shaping policing to 2040, from robot patrols to AI-led investigations, while MBZUAI and Inception42 shipped Jais 3 with Arabic speech recognition and Saudi's SDAIA launched a public deepfake-awareness campaign. The Gulf keeps buying and operating AI at scale, setting a state-adoption template.
themes.angle: The Gulf's AI story is deployment speed and government adoption, the angle global briefs miss.

themes.title: DeepSeek, Anchor and Brin: the inference-cost race
themes.summary: DeepSeek shipped an updated model it says is faster and leaner, intensifying the price war against OpenAI, Anthropic and domestic rivals, while new agent-infrastructure plays like Anchor's Action Index claim 100x token-cost cuts for computer-use agents. Unit economics, not benchmarks, now decide which stacks deploy at scale.
themes.angle: Watch cost-per-outcome, not leaderboard position: the cheapest scaled deployment wins enterprise spend.

themes.title: AI capex meets the debt market: double-digit-yield compute
themes.summary: Anthropic offered Blackstone double-digit yields in its latest chip financing, a sign that high borrowing costs complicate the lab's investment-grade ambitions, while SoftBank steps up robotics-and-AI acquisitions and Fincantieri funnels $100M into shipyard AI. Capital is available, but the price of it is rising fast.
themes.angle: Double-digit-yield compute debt is a leading indicator of margin compression across the AI stack.

themes.title: McKinsey's exec playbook: value over adoption
themes.summary: McKinsey published a run of executive-grade AI pieces this week: an AI operating system view for CEOs, the judgment bottleneck between AI-speed analysis and human-speed decisions, the real cost of moving pilots to production, and a value curve for applying AI to existing work. The throughline: measure value, not adoption.
themes.angle: The consulting consensus is hardening around value capture; boards should too.

items.note: McKinsey: most firms measure adoption instead of value; the curve shows where automation pays most.
